subject: Help resolving Javascript error when multiple D3 based htmlwidgets are used as outputs

messages.author: 3d4e86928d53f8e3
messages.subject: Help resolving Javascript error when multiple D3 based htmlwidgets are used as outputs
parts:
Hi,

I have come accross an issue where my shiny app is not rendering an interactive table (D3TableFilter) whenever I include a collapisbleTree output.
I get the following error in Chrome's console:

TypeError: undefined is not a constructor (evaluating 'table.append("thead")')

Here's a simple app that replicates the problem:

library(shiny)
library(D3TableFilter)
library(collapsibleTree)

ui <- shinyUI(
   fluidPage(
      title = 'Test App',
      fluidRow(
         column(width = 12, 
                d3tfOutput('d3table'),
                collapsibleTreeOutput("d3tree")
         )
      )
   )
)

server <- shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
   
   output$d3table <- renderD3tf({
      df <- data.frame(Titanic)
      d3tf(df,
           tableStyle = "table table-hover")
   })
   
   output$d3tree <- renderCollapsibleTree({
      df <- data.frame(Titanic)
      collapsibleTree(df, hierarchy = c("Class", "Sex", "Age", "Survived"))
   })
   
})

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

Unfortunately I'm not sure where to begin to debug the issue.
Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Cheers

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Help resolving Javascript error when multiple D3 based htmlwidgets are used as outputs
parts: I'd report the JavaScript error to the author of the collapsibleTree package. Once a JavaScript error occurs it's not surprising other outputs are affected; Shiny isn't designed to be resilient to bugs in custom widget types (though hmmm, maybe it should be...)
